_note: Does a release have to ship with playable recordings?
The 691 mp3s are gitignored (~1 GB), so a build from a fresh clone — which
is what Vercel does — has none of them. They reach production only from an
external host named by VITE_AUDIO_BASE. When that was neither set up nor
noticed, every deploy silently shipped without music and the app told
readers the hymns had never been recorded.
So the answer lives here, in version control, where changing it is a commit
someone can see — rather than in an environment variable whose absence is
Now true: the 691 recordings live in a Vercel Blob store and VITE_AUDIO_BASE
points at it. check-audio.mjs samples that URL on every build, so a release
can no longer ship with the music silently missing.
